label: institutional officer of
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified professional officer role in institution Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit officer of/with/at institutional role; historical institutional officership. Excludes: ordinary employment or membership without an officer title; researcher, observer, analyst or director alone; inferring executive rank or governmental authority from the word officer. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear officer title or institutional attachment; a personal principal or topic replacing the institution. This specific officer title is distinct from executive_of and official_of. It does not assert senior management or a government office.

facts.reason: Loren Thompson → Lexington Institute: Explicit officer-of and officer-with establish the professional institutional office.
